mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20d returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in UNRATE above 7.0% triggers concerns about labor market tightness, leading to negative S&P 500 20d returns as investors anticipate higher inflation and rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p <0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply index) signals robust production growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 20d returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) during sustained INDPRO growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly rises in FEDFUNDS (monetary) and GDPC1 (demand) indicate dual easing, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 20d returns.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 rise in the same month
failure_condition: 60d returns not positively correlated with the interaction (Pearson r <0.2 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS predicts monetary easing, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 20d returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) during late-cycle expansions when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (demand) crosses above 900, it signals heightened demand for goods, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 20d returns.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) upon crossing above 900.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in CPIAUCSL above 233.8 (current level) signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of higher rates and negative S&P 500 20d returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p <0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 233.8.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly rises in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor demand) indicate robust economic expansion, lowering risk aversion and driving positive S&P 500 20d returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and PAYEMS rise in the same month
failure_condition: 60d returns not positively correlated with the interaction (Pearson r <0.2 over 3-year window).
